captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a simple, flat rectangular base plate designed to serve as a customizable label or nameplate. It has a low-profile, solid rectangular shape with clean straight edges and sharp corners. The surface is completely flat, serving as a clean canvas for raised text or other identifiers to be added on top.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric label base plate with customizable dimensions and optional raised text. The user should be able to adjust the overall width, height, and base thickness, as well as the text string, font, and text thickness for multi-color printing.
captions.factory: The code defines a parametric label system using two main modules: 'maincolor' and 'topcolor'. The 'maincolor' module creates the base plate using a single 'cube' primitive defined by 'width', 'height', and 'baseThick'. The 'topcolor' module positions the text on top of the base plate using a 'translate' transform and the external 'write' library to render the custom font dynamically. Conditional 'if-else' statements allow the user to render either the bottom plate, the top text, or both parts together for dual-extrusion 3D printing.
